The next pick.
The right reason.

An advisor beside DotaCaptain’s draft. Reads the revealed picks and bans, ranks available heroes with the game’s native AI formulas, and explains counters, synergies, roles and capability gaps.

Install Draft AdvisorTry the practice board

Free static tool. Install a userscript manager first. Recommendations are manual by default. Start Auto in the installed panel to let it submit this match’s actions.

Reads the live draft

Detects the rendered 24-turn history and captures the scout only when it is visible. Manual correction is available if the page layout changes.

Ranks and explains

Top picks and bans update with the draft. Search by hero, filter by role, and see the source counter and synergy reasons behind the recommendations.

Checks configurations

After five picks, see a native draft-value plan. When both teams are known, compare strategy configurations and optimized item purchase orders against a quick check or all 64 enemy strategies.

Install once. Open DotaCaptain.

  1. Install Tampermonkey from its official browser-store links for your browser.
  2. Open Install Draft Advisor and confirm the userscript installation in the manager. If the script opens as text, create a new userscript in the manager, paste the file and save.
  3. Open DotaCaptain. Start a draft and leave the advisor enabled during the scout briefing.
  4. Read Top picks or Top bans, or enable Start Auto once the draft is detected. Auto varies strong native choices, confirms actions, runs Quick configuration optimization and clicks Continue. Stop Auto or Escape takes over.

Daily Challenge: open Daily and click Start Auto Daily. It preserves existing picks, fills the available slots and submits once. Daily assigns roles, strategy and items on its server.

The userscript runs on DotaCaptain pages so it can survive navigation into draft. It reads visible draft information, keeps the scout in memory for this page session, and does not call account APIs or upload draft data. Auto uses visible game controls and stops when detection or controls are uncertain. Auto searches and applies ordered item builds before confirming.
